Freego X1 All-Terrain Electric Dirt Bike with Pedals

The Freego X1 is an all-terrain electric dirt bike with pedals built for riders who want strong performance for off-road riding and everyday adventures. Powered by a 1500W nominal / 3000W peak motor and a 60V 25Ah battery, the X1 reaches speeds of up to 37 MPH while delivering responsive power across varied terrain.

Why Riders Choose the Freego X1

The Freego X1 is built for riders who want more power, responsive control, and all-terrain capability. Its 1500W nominal / 3000W peak motor delivers strong acceleration and a top speed of up to 37 MPH, while the high-strength steel frame, full suspension, motorcycle-grade tires, and 4-piston hydraulic brakes provide confident handling across city streets, trails, and varied terrain.

Key Specifications

Motor Power 1500W (Nominal) / 3000W (Peak)

Top Speed Up to 37 MPH

Battery 60V, 25Ah (1620Wh)

Riding Range 20–50 Mi

Throttle Type Full-Twist Throttle

Controller Brushless Motor Controller, 45A / 200A

Frame High-Strength Steel

Display LCD Display

Max Load 264 lb (120 kg)

Net Weight 117 lb (53 kg)

Charging Time 6–8 H

Transmission Single Speed

Brake System 4-Piston Hydraulic Brakes

Suspension Full Suspension

Turn Signals Yes

Brake Light Yes

Wheel Type & Size Spoke Wheels, Front/Rear 17 × 1.4 Alloy Rims

Tire Type & Size 70/100–17 (2.75 × 17 in) Tubed, Pneumatic Motorcycle-Grade Tires, Puncture-Resistant

Package Size 61” × 11.4” × 34.2” (155 × 29 × 87 cm)

Suggested Rider Height 5’3”–6’1” (160–185 cm)

Range Note

Actual riding range may vary depending on rider weight, speed, terrain, temperature, wind, tire pressure, payload, and riding mode.

FAQ

What is the Freego X1 motor power?
The Freego X1 features a 1500W nominal motor with up to 3000W peak power.

How fast can the Freego X1 go?
The Freego X1 can reach a top speed of up to 37 MPH.

What battery and range does the Freego X1 have?
The X1 features a 60V 25Ah (1620Wh) battery with a listed riding range of 20–50 miles.
